english.title: Guilty of act or neglect whereby waterworks water used for human consumption/domestic purposes likely to be polluted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of

(A)_[an act,]_
(B)_[neglect,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ACT OR NEGLECT..), whereby the water in waterworks at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) which was used or was likely to be used for

(C)_[human consumption or domestic purposes]_
(D)_[manufacturing food or drink for human consumption]_

was polluted or likely to be polluted
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72(1) and (4) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were guilty of an act or neglect
whereby water in a waterworks
which was used or was likely to be used for human consumption or domestic purposes
was polluted or was likely to be polluted

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 72(2) and (3) for allowable restrictions
(ii) See section 72(5) for definition of waterworks

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum and, in the case of a continuing offence, to a further fine not exceeding £50 for every day during which the offence is continued after conviction
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

libra.complexpenaltydetails: In the case of a continuing offence, on summary conviction, the defendant is liable to a further fine not exceeding £50 for every day during which the offence is continued after conviction
